006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.DefaultIndexHasKeyConstraint;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * Represents a rule that checks that a key generated for a Metaschema data
015 * object exists in a named index that was generated using an
016 * {@link IIndexConstraint}.
017 */
018public interface IIndexHasKeyConstraint extends IKeyConstraint {
019  @Override
020  default Type getType() {
021    return Type.INDEX_HAS_KEY;
022  }
023
024  /**
025   * The name of the index used to verify cross references.
026   *
027   * @return the name of the index this constraint uses for lookups
028   */
029  @NonNull
030  String getIndexName();
031
032  @Override
033  default <T, R> R accept(IConstraintVisitor<T, R> visitor, T state) {
034    return visitor.visitIndexHasKeyConstraint(this, state);
035  }
036
037  /**
038   * Create a new constraint builder.
039   *
040   * @param useIndex
041   *          the index name
042   * @return the builder
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  static Builder builder(@NonNull String useIndex) {
046    return new Builder(useIndex);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Provides a builder pattern for constructing a new
051   * {@link IIndexHasKeyConstraint}.
052   */
053  final class Builder
054      extends AbstractKeyConstraintBuilder<Builder, IIndexHasKeyConstraint> {
055    @NonNull
056    private final String indexName;
057
058    private Builder(@NonNull String useIndex) {
059      // disable construction
060      this.indexName = useIndex;
061    }
062
063    @Override
064    protected Builder getThis() {
065      return this;
066    }
067
068    @NonNull
069    private String getIndexName() {
070      return indexName;
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    protected IIndexHasKeyConstraint newInstance() {
075      return new DefaultIndexHasKeyConstraint(
076          getId(),
077          getFormalName(),
078          getDescription(),
079          ObjectUtils.notNull(getSource()),
080          getLevel(),
081          getTarget(),
082          getProperties(),
083          getIndexName(),
084          getKeyFields(),
085          getMessage(),
086          getRemarks());
087    }
088  }
089}
